description: A unit reclaim's step across stock's 32-bit wrap (B10), on Show Down. 0x438650 multiplies the reclaimer's workertime, (kills + 5)/5, the target's MaxHitPoints and the 15 ticks between steps; ARMCOM's 300 on a CORKROG wraps at the factor 32, 155 kills. Four ARMCOMs of the player's, at 0, 150, 155 and 1000 kills (factors 1, 31, 32, 201), each reclaim a CORKROG of the player's; read each target's HP (+0x108) as it falls, one step every 15 ticks. Stock: 0 and 150 take the formula's step, 155 a sliver (the product less 2^32), 1000 whatever the wrap leaves. B10: every one the formula's step.
